decisions.reason: Changing the badge catalog to eight displayed badges in two rows and excluding Legend does not change the existing referral-milestone award triggers or on-chain award recording.
The FAQ describes badge purpose and milestone awards but does not specify the badge count, Legend inclusion, or dashboard row layout.
The About page only mentions badges and leaderboards generically; its approved copy remains valid without catalog-count or row-layout changes.
The Mission page refers generically to badges and leaderboards and contains no Legend badge, badge-count, or layout detail requiring revision.
The badge catalog and row arrangement do not affect the landing-page book cover's placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The landing-page mechanics copy contains no badge catalog or badge-layout state affected by the source decision.
The hero's headline, CTA, layout, and visual emphasis are independent of the dashboard badge count and row arrangement.
Changing badge presentation does not alter the mint-number referral code's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The badge catalog and row layout do not change the current or planned product names.
The badge-layout clause of message 313 does not change the connected-wallet USDC mint flow; other clauses in the same message are outside the source Event's semantics.
The source Event changes dashboard badge presentation, not NFT-detail cover sizing or visibility; the message's separate NFT-size observation is already represented independently.
Displaying eight badges in two rows and removing Legend does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, ticket window, reset behavior, or pool funding.
